titulo.es: How much clearcutting can nature sustain? A study determines the ecological limit for boreal forest birds
titulo.en: How much clearcutting can nature sustain? A study determines the ecological limit for boreal forest birds

sintesis.es: A study led by the University of Jyväskylä in Finland evaluated, for the first time, an ecological threshold for the amount of clearcutting in boreal forests. According to the results, maintaining populations of bird species specialized in old-growth forests requires either a forest rotation period of at least 90 years on average or that approximately one-fifth of the forest area be excluded from clearcut management. The study provides a concrete target for the ecologically sustainable use of forests.

titulo.es: Nuevos rescates con vida diez días después de la catastrófica riada en Nepal
titulo.en: New survivors rescued ten days after Nepal's devastating flood

sintesis.es: Diez días después del deslave de hielo, piedra y barro que mató a más de 1.300 personas en Nepal y el Tíbet el 26 de agosto, dos personas más fueron rescatadas con vida: un trabajador chino atrapado en un túnel de la central hidroeléctrica Trishuli y una mujer de 64 años sepultada bajo lodo en su vivienda en Nuwakot. Estos rescates se suman a otros dos ocurridos un día antes, dando esperanza a las labores de búsqueda mientras más de 5.000 personas continúan desaparecidas. La catástrofe también dañó más del 10% de la capacidad hidroeléctrica del país, evidenciando la vulnerabilidad de la dependencia energética de Nepal en este sector.
sintesis.en: Ten days after a deadly ice, rock and mudslide killed more than 1,300 people in Nepal and Tibet on August 26, two more survivors were rescued: a Chinese worker trapped in a tunnel at the Trishuli hydropower plant and a 64-year-old woman buried under mud in her home in Nuwakot. These rescues follow two others found alive the previous day, boosting hope for ongoing search operations as more than 5,000 people remain missing. The disaster also knocked out over 10% of the country's hydropower generation capacity, exposing the vulnerability of Nepal's heavy reliance on this energy source.

titulo.es: Brote de sarampión en Bangladesh se acerca a las 1,000 muertes infantiles
titulo.en: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh nears 1,000 child deaths

sintesis.es: Bangladesh enfrenta su brote de sarampión más mortal en décadas, con hospitales saturados de niños y bebés afectados y un saldo cercano a las mil muertes infantiles en seis meses. Las autoridades sanitarias señalan que la desnutrición y la escasez de alimentos agravan la crisis, mientras trabajan para contener la epidemia.
sintesis.en: Bangladesh is facing its deadliest measles outbreak in decades, with hospitals overwhelmed by sick children and infants and a death toll nearing 1,000 over six months. Health authorities point to malnutrition and food shortages as key factors worsening the crisis while efforts continue to control the outbreak.

titulo.es: Suspensión masiva de vuelos en el principal aeropuerto de Indonesia por la erupción de un volcán
titulo.en: Indonesia’s most dangerous fires are burning underground

sintesis.es: El monte Anak Krakatoa es un volcán activo situado en el estrecho de Sonda, entre las islas de Java y Sumatra.
sintesis.en: Indonesia’s dangerous peat fires are surging early in the 2026 fire season as a strengthening El Niño and severe drought dry out wetlands that can burn underground for months. These slow smoldering fires are especially destructive because they release far more fine particles and several pollutants than typical tropical forest fires, while thick smoke can make them difficult for satellites to detect.

titulo.es: Paris hosts African Diaspora International Film Festival
titulo.en: Paris hosts African Diaspora International Film Festival

sintesis.es: This weekend, Paris is hosting the 16th edition of FIFDA, the African Diaspora International Film Festival. From September 4 to 6, 15 films from 13 countries will be screened, spanning fiction and non-fiction, as well as feature-length and short films. The festival provides a space to explore how contemporary societies face and overcome wounds from the past, while giving a voice to members of African diasporas.
